title: Mask Adoption Simulation
description: Simulate how individuals adopt and sustain face mask use over time under social influence, observation, information campaigns, and policy interventions.

interactions.name: social_influence
interactions.description: Peer-to-peer influence via social network ties and co-location; observed mask use and communicated attitudes shift an individual's propensity to wear masks.

interactions.name: policy_influence
interactions.description: HealthAuthority issues guidance or mandates that change location rules and individual compliance decisions.

interactions.name: enforcement
interactions.description: Locations and/or HealthAuthority apply enforcement (warnings/fines); individuals decide whether to comply based on enforcement level and personal traits.

interactions.name: observation_in_public
interactions.description: Individuals observe the proportion of others masked at locations; perceived norms update attitudes and immediate behavior.

interactions.name: information_diffusion
interactions.description: InformationSource and person-to-person communication update risk perception, trust, and mask attitudes (including misinformation effects).

interactions.name: mask_acquisition
interactions.description: Individuals acquire masks subject to availability and cost; ownership enables future wearing behavior.

metrics.name: adoption_rate_over_time
metrics.description: Proportion of individuals wearing a mask at each time step.

metrics.name: time_to_50_percent_adoption
metrics.description: Days elapsed until adoption rate first reaches 50%.

metrics.name: time_to_70_percent_adoption
metrics.description: Days elapsed until adoption rate first reaches 70%.

metrics.name: steady_state_adoption
metrics.description: Average adoption rate over the final phase of the simulation (e.g., last 10% of days).

metrics.name: compliance_rate
metrics.description: Proportion of individuals complying when mandates are active.

metrics.name: group_disparity_index
metrics.description: Difference or ratio in adoption rates between demographic groups (e.g., SES, age).

metrics.name: churn_rate
metrics.description: Rate at which individuals switch between masked and unmasked states across days.

metrics.name: enforcement_actions_count
metrics.description: Number of warnings or fines issued over time.

metrics.name: campaign_efficiency
metrics.description: Adoption gain per unit of campaign intensity or budget.
